questions.question:
Select the number – pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two numbers of the following number – pair

28 : 63
questions.solution:
Ratio of 28 : 63 is (4)/(9)

Similarly,

Ration of 16 : 36 is (4)/(9)

Hence answer is 16 : 36.

questions.question:
Which two signa should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

12 – 6 ÷ 12 × 6 + 6 = 9
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and ÷

12 - 6 + 12 × 6 ÷ 6 = 12 - 6 + 12 × 1

6 + 12 ≠ 9

Interchanging × and +

12 - 6 div 12 + 6 times 6 = 12 - (6)/({12)} + 36

48 - (1)/(2) ne 9

Interchanging – and +

12 + 6 div 12 times 6 - 6 = 12 + (6)/({12)} times 6 - 6

**12 + 3 - 6 = 9**

Interchanging ÷ and ×

12 - 6 × 12 ÷ 6 + 6 = 12 - 6 × 2 + 6

12 - 12 + 6 ≠ 9

Hence by interchanging – and + we get correct equation.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(12, 16, 28)

Rs. 820 is divided among 6 men, 8 women, and 12 boys in such a way that every woman gets an amount equal to that received by one man and one boy combined and that every man gets one and a half times the amount received by a boy. What is the total amount received by 8 women?
questions.solution:
Let amount received by 1 boy = X

Then amount received by 1 man = 1.5 X

And amount received by 1 woman = 2.5 X

Total amount = (12 × X + 6 × 1.5X + 8 × 2.5X ) = (12X + 9X + 20X)

(12X + 9X + 20X) = 820

41X = 820

X = 20

Amount received by 1 woman = 20 × 2.5 = 50

Amount received by 8 women’s = 50 × 8 = 400.

Hence 400 is correct answer.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) form the statements.

**Statements:**

Some students are players

Some players are athletes

Conclusions:

I. Some students are athletes.

II. Some players are students

III. No students is an athlete.

options.text: Only conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9db261db38b4ded37de2c3ae7e1f7e489c3e7bbf361e5ac4ea8ab00a3652d29d.png] 

Some students are athletes → False

Some players are students → True

No students is an athlete → False

Conclusion I and III are complimentary.

Hence Only conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follow.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

dc_abc_cb_bcd_ba_c
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

Here d c b a b c is repeating term.

d c **b** a b c **d** c b **a** b c d** c** b a **b** c is complete series.

Hence **b d a c b** will complete the series.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(15, 22, 31)

Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Which number will be at the top if 1 is at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1317ced9d54263de23b4ac4dc6c6de0640066509ad435cf44f3db62b82cbccab.png]
questions.solution:
If we rotate 1st cube to get 3 on the front face and 2 on the bottom face.

1, 6 are adjacent to 3 in 1st cube and 2, 4 are adjacent to 3 in 2ⁿd cube.

6 is at top and 2 is on the bottom if we rotate the cube.

So 1 and 4 will be opposite to each other

Hence 4 will be on top when 1 is at the bottom.
